execution_mode: schema validation replay; no model inference
scope: Eight developer-authored mutations of the synthetic fixture, not a general safety benchmark.
semantic_boundary: Checks declared scope and structured claims; does not verify source text or external truth.

cases.label: Keep correctly scoped evidence
cases.change: Use the existing Android device-failure record for its Android device check.
cases.reason: Valid provenance is accepted even when the business result is a blocker.

cases.label: Reuse an iOS pass for Android
cases.change: Set Android currency approval to met using lantern_ios_currency_approved.
cases.reason: A real source ID is insufficient when it describes another platform.

errors.message: Value error, Fact evidence integration scope does not match integration

cases.label: Use a connection test to prove approval
cases.change: Set Android currency approval to met using lantern_android_sdk_connected.
cases.reason: The app matches, but SDK connection does not establish currency approval.

errors.message: Value error, Fact evidence check scope does not match check

cases.label: Borrow another customer's contact
cases.change: Replace Lantern's last-contact reference with contact_acc_011 from Orbit.
cases.reason: Another customer's recent contact must not remove Lantern from the follow-up queue.

errors.message: Value error, Contact evidence account scope does not match account

cases.label: Overwrite the handoff platform
cases.change: Insert platform: iOS into the Android issue's free-form details.
cases.reason: App and platform come from the validated integration, not ticket detail fields.

cases.label: Turn a recorded failure into a pass
cases.change: Change the Android device-check fact to met, leaving its not_met source claim intact.
cases.reason: Matching source ownership does not permit reversing what the source asserts.

errors.message: Value error, Evidence claim conflicts with fact state; preserve uncertainty

cases.label: Keep disagreement visible
cases.change: Add a contrary Android customer report and retain both records under an unknown device-check state.
cases.reason: The schema accepts explicit uncertainty; it does not decide which report is true.

cases.label: Treat a blank SDK version as missing
cases.change: Set the SDK version to whitespace only.
cases.reason: Whitespace cannot satisfy the engineering handoff's required information.
